videos.t: Cleaning and re-lubricating MGN carriages (READ DESCRIPTION FIRST!)
videos.desc:
PLEASE READ FIRST: This video was made during a time when most rails were pretty gritty out of the bag. This is USUALLY no longer the case and disassembling the rails now should only be a last resort if your rails feel "chunky" during inspection, a quick flush and re-lubing should be all they need, no need to disassemble. Also, do not mix up bearings between carriages either.

Quick video on how i disassemble, clean, lube and re-assemble mgn9h carriages and rails for the voron v2

Link to all voron information and community Links
http://vorondesign.com/
Approved BOM sourcing guide

videos.desc:

https://github.com/Arksine/moonraker/blob/master/docs/configuration.md#paneldue
Steps:
1. Swapping ports used by GPIO and Bluetooth
The first thing to enable serial connection is to swap ports used by the GPIO (soldered pins) and the internal Bluetooth chip. We need to add a line in the config file on the boot partition.

sudo nano /boot/firmware/config.txt
Move the cursor to the very end and add:
dtoverlay=pi3-miniuart-bt

2. Disabling the serial console

Moving to another config file, where part of the code must be deleted to disable serial console.

videos.t: Quick Klipper Tips - Expanding your 3dp toolkit
videos.desc:
How to keep the lights from flickering? Why am i getting movement errors? and how to keep things organized, those tips and more in todays video!

Resolve heater flicker
Add
pwm_cycle_time: 0.01666 (if 60hz power grid)
pwm_cycle_time: 0.02        (if 50hz power grid)

Want to use multiple .cfg files to keep things organized?
name them xxx.cfg and have [include xxx.cfg] in your printer.cfg file

Easy access to the klipper.bin file?
After running the MAKE command run
cp out/klipper.bin ../klipper_config/firmware.bin

videos.t: Upgrading V2.026 in prep for Voron TAP - LIVESTREAM! #livestream #3dprinting
videos.desc:
